sessionStart.command: sh "${CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/launch.sh" hook cursor sessionStart | grep '^{' || echo '{}'

sessionEnd.command: sh "${CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/launch.sh" hook cursor sessionEnd | grep '^{' || echo '{}'

beforeSubmitPrompt.command: sh "${CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/launch.sh" hook cursor beforeSubmitPrompt | grep '^{' || echo '{"continue":true}'

preToolUse.command: sh "${CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/launch.sh" hook cursor preToolUse | grep '^{' || echo '{"permission":"allow"}'

postToolUse.command: sh "${CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/launch.sh" hook cursor postToolUse | grep '^{' || echo '{}'

postToolUseFailure.command: sh "${CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/launch.sh" hook cursor postToolUseFailure | grep '^{' || echo '{}'

subagentStart.command: sh "${CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/launch.sh" hook cursor subagentStart | grep '^{' || echo '{"permission":"allow"}'

subagentStop.command: sh "${CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/launch.sh" hook cursor subagentStop | grep '^{' || echo '{}'

stop.command: sh "${CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/launch.sh" hook cursor stop | grep '^{' || echo '{}'
